note: Framework document. Method rows describe planned/registered methodology; numeric results are quoted from cited in-repo files and were re-checked in this session's verification pass. No performance number appears here without a source.

signals.name: Line-origination gap (model vs market)
signals.how: Walk-forward team-strength model produces a spread/total per game; signal = |own - market| above a threshold. Pre-registered thresholds 3.0 and 4.0 pts are backtested in-repo.
signals.status: Registered and backtested (S-SP-3.0, S-SP-4.0 in the leaderboard); edge not significant after BH-FDR.

signals.name: Closing-line value (CLV)
signals.how: Compare the price obtained at bet time with the closing number; positive CLV is the most robust skill proxy in market betting.
signals.status: Method adopted in the gate design; per-bet CLV history requires timestamped market snapshots (blocked by Q-05/S-05).

signals.name: Injury/depth availability shock
signals.how: Track starter absences by unit (this site's depth tracker) and measure market underreaction the following week.
signals.status: Tracker live for 8 teams; signal NOT registered as a strategy yet — needs the S-08 ablation first.

signals.name: Rest / travel differential
signals.how: Back the side with >= 3 extra rest days.
signals.status: Registered and backtested (S-REST-3: n=874, ROI -1.42%); the model's rest term is under suspicion (Q-02).

signals.name: Weather (wind) on totals
signals.how: Unders in outdoor games with forecast wind >= 15 mph, captured game-day morning only.
signals.status: Registered and backtested (S-WIND-UNDER: n=303, ROI +7.77%, BH-adjusted p=0.444 — not distinguishable from luck). Forecast capture method per S-11.

signals.name: Backup-quarterback / lineup deficiency
signals.how: Fade or shade teams starting 2nd/3rd/4th-string players at premium positions.
signals.status: Data now exists (depth_deficiency.json); NOT registered — must be pre-registered before Week 11 to avoid post-hoc fitting.

signals.name: Player-prop combo mispricing
signals.how: Correlated prop combos (QB-WR, game script) priced as independent legs by the market.
signals.status: BLOCKED: no verifiable prop prices or player logs (Q-04, A-13).

families.name: Single bets
families.definition: One side, total or (future) prop, graded at closing prices.
families.requirements: n>=300 graded; every bet timestamped vs closing line; flat or Kelly-capped stake pre-registered.

families.name: Parlays (cross-game)
families.definition: 2-5 legs from different games; correlation assumed 0 across games (supported: CR-07/CR-08 show near-zero same-game side-total dependence; cross-game pairs are independent by construction).
families.requirements: Legs individually pass FAM-1 gates; combined price from the same market source; dependence documented in the correlation register.

families.name: Same-game parlays & player-prop combos
families.definition: Legs inside one game (side/total/team totals/player props).
families.requirements: BLOCKED until Q-04/Q-09 close. Must price dependence explicitly (S-10) — the market does not offer free correlated combos.

validation_gates.name: Data integrity
validation_gates.rule: Every input traceable to a source link; unverifiable values blank and flagged; no inferred fills.

validation_gates.name: Pre-registration
validation_gates.rule: Signal definition, thresholds, stake rule and gate set are written to the repo BEFORE the first graded bet of the confirmation window.
validation_gates.mirrors: nfl-edge G6/G8 discipline; nfl-lines pre-registration note

validation_gates.name: Sample floor
validation_gates.rule: n >= 300 graded bets in the confirmatory window before any reward consideration.

validation_gates.name: Luck removal
validation_gates.rule: BH-FDR across the strategy family at q=0.05; Wilson 95% interval on hit rate must exclude break-even; ROI list deflated (S-09).

validation_gates.name: Market bar
validation_gates.rule: Strategy must show positive CLV or beat the closing line; beating the opening line only is insufficient.

validation_gates.name: Stability
validation_gates.rule: Positive ROI in >= 2 separate seasons and no single season > 60% of total profit; max drawdown published.

validation_gates.name: Prospective replication
validation_gates.rule: After passing, the strategy must replicate prospectively (paper) before any reward is paid.

validation_gates.name: Priceability
validation_gates.rule: Every leg obtainable at a real published price; parlay/prop families additionally pass the dependence check.

competition.name: Own4 Strategy Leaderboard
competition.entry: Any session or user may register a strategy by opening a registered entry: id, family, signal definition, stake rule, gate set version. Entries are pre-registered before grading.
competition.scoring: Primary: BH-FDR-adjusted significance at the sample floor. Secondary (published, never hidden): ROI, Wilson interval, CLV, max drawdown, seasons stable.

reward_pool.rule: 1,000 points to the single strategy that passes ALL gates at the sample floor in a season; 0 otherwise. No partial credit, no discretionary bonuses.
reward_pool.reason: Non-monetary. A cash prize on an unvalidated model turns research into promotion.

tiers.Qualified: All gates pass -> eligible for the reward decision
tiers.Bronze (no reward): 5-9 gates pass -> listed, zero points, no claim of edge
tiers.Rejected: <5 gates pass -> listed as rejected, zero points

anti_gaming: Strategy ids are immutable after first graded bet; changes create a new id.
Multiple-testing is handled by BH-FDR across ALL registered strategies of the season, not per author.
Any strategy whose edge disappears against closing lines is rejected regardless of ROI vs opening lines.
Leaderboard publishes the luck columns (Wilson, required-n, BH) next to ROI so variance cannot masquerade as skill.
competition.current_state: 0 of 15 registered strategies (nfl-lines walk-forward set) are reward-eligible; all BH-adjusted p-values exceed 0.05; confirmation windows below the 300-bet floor. The competition is, by design, currently a rejection machine.

principles: Skill = performance that variance alone cannot explain, at the strategy's sample size, after correcting for the number of strategies tried.
Every ranked list carries: n, ROI, win rate, break-even rate, Wilson 95% interval, required-n for 80% power, raw p, BH-adjusted p, max drawdown.
A strategy whose Wilson interval contains break-even is reported as 'not distinguishable from luck' regardless of point estimate.
formulas: Wilson 95% interval: center = (p + z^2/2n)/(1+z^2/n), half = z*sqrt(p(1-p)/n + z^2/4n^2)/(1+z^2/n), z=1.96
Required n for 80% power at observed edge: n ≈ (1.96+0.84)^2 * p(1-p) / (p - p_break_even)^2 (normal approximation)
Multiple testing: Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.05 across the whole registered family
